title: Magento 1.9 to Magento 2: a six-weekend live cutover
lede: A Dutch agency had to move a Magento 1.9 store onto 2.4.7 without ever freezing the catalog. This is the six-weekend rebuild plan that actually held.
hero_alt: Overhead view of a six-week paper cutover calendar, Magento migration run-sheet, brass plate, wax seal, ruler, pencil on linen.
